page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr8i.4xlarge is an x86_64 server instance running on the KVM hypervisor within the High Clock Speed instance family. It provides 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor operating at a 3.3 GHz clock speed. The server features 128.0 GB of system memory, resulting in an allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The hardware setup does not include local storage or graphics accelerators, directing persistent storage operations to remote cloud volumes. Network interfaces offer a baseline throughput of 16 Gbps.

The instance delivers a combination of elevated CPU clock frequencies and a memory-heavy 1:8 core-to-RAM ratio. By utilizing dedicated vCPU allocations, the instance avoids resource contention issues typical of shared multi-tenant hosts. A operational tradeoff is the total reliance on networked block storage for disk transactions, which places a higher priority on managing external input and output operations against the 16 Gbps baseline network capacity. From a resource perspective, it offers high memory density alongside sustained single-thread compute capabilities.

The ecs.hfr8i.4xlarge is tailored for workloads requiring significant random-access memory alongside high processor clock speeds. Target deployments include in-memory databases, large caching layers such as Redis or Memcached, memory-bound enterprise software, and extract, transform, load pipelines processing large data sets in memory.
